name: Best Chance (shuttle)
description: Best Chance was a New Republic shuttle in operation during the Yuuzhan Vong War. In 25 ABY, it ferried a commando team of six Noghri and three Jedi: Jacen Solo, Corran Horn, and Ganner Rhysode, hidden within the decoy freighter Lost Hope, from Ralroost to the surface of Garqi.
